mapper.select: select sc.id as categoryId, sc.name as name, (select count(*)from product p where p.shop_id = sc.shop_id and p.category_id = sc.id and p.deleted = 0) as productCount from shop_category sc where sc.shop_id = #{shopId} and sc.deleted = 0 order by sc.sort,sc.id
select coalesce(max(sort),0) from takeout.shop_category where shop_id = #{shopId} and deleted = 0
